---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: DNV Certification
Date: {{INNER_DATE}}
Subject: MV NORDIC ICE — Annual Class Survey complete

Dear Sirs,

This is to confirm that DNV has completed the annual class survey for MV NORDIC ICE (Demo).

Vessel particulars:
- Vessel: MV NORDIC ICE (Demo)
- IMO: 9356787
- Class Notation: +1A1 General Cargo, Ice Class 1A FS (Finnish-Swedish), DNV
- DWT: 28,500 mts (summer)

Survey results:
- Annual survey completed: 12 April 2026 in Helsinki
- Status: Class maintained
- Next intermediate survey due: 15 October 2026 in Northern Europe
- Class certificate valid until: 14 March 2027

Ice class verification:
- Notation Ice 1A FS confirmed
- Hull plating, frames, propulsion all compliant with Finnish-Swedish Ice Class Rules
- Vessel cleared for Baltic winter operations

Kind regards,
DNV — Certification Department
snippet: Annual class survey complete for MV NORDIC ICE — Ice Class 1A FS confirmed valid until March 2027
